description: This Java source file defines the 'InboundDispatchingActor' class, which is an Akka actor responsible for dispatching and handling inbound messages within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging service. It includes message processing logic, header and signal transformations, error handling, acknowledgement processing, and interaction with other actors like proxies and monitoring components.

classes.name: InboundDispatchingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for dispatching and processing inbound messages within the Eclipse Ditto messaging framework. Handles message mapping, error processing, acknowledgement management, and communication with other actors.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates the Props configuration for the InboundDispatchingActor with provided dependencies.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling behavior, including handling of mapped outcomes, exceptions, and unknown messages.

methods.name: onMapped
methods.description: Handles successfully mapped inbound messages, applying header and signal transformations and monitoring.

methods.name: onDropped
methods.description: Handles cases where message mapping results in dropping the message.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors occurring during message processing, generating appropriate error responses and logging.

methods.name: dispatchError
methods.description: Dispatches error mapping outcomes to the error handler.

methods.name: dispatchMapped
methods.description: Processes successfully mapped messages, dispatching signals and managing acknowledgements.

methods.name: getDeclaredAckLabels
methods.description: Retrieves acknowledgement labels declared in the external message source.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Extracts the source address from an external message.

methods.name: dispatchResponsesAndSearchCommands
methods.description: Generates a dispatching function for handling different signal types and responses.

methods.name: dispatchIncomingSignal
methods.description: Handles incoming signals that request acknowledgement or forwards signals to other actors.

methods.name: isLive
methods.description: Determines if a signal is considered 'live' (e.g., Command or live ThingCommand).

methods.name: startAckregatorAndForwardSignal
methods.description: Starts an acknowledgement aggregator actor and forwards the signal appropriately.

methods.name: handleErrorDuringStartingOfAckregator
methods.description: Handles exceptions during acknowledgement aggregator startup.

methods.name: forwardToConnectionActor
methods.description: Forwards signals to the connection actor for further processing.

methods.name: forwardAcknowledgement
methods.description: Handles acknowledgement signals, routing them based on declared labels.

methods.name: forwardAcknowledgements
methods.description: Handles multiple acknowledgements, verifying labels and forwarding accordingly.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Builds a topic path based on acknowledgement signals.

methods.name: newTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing topic paths based on entity IDs.

methods.name: getReturnAddress
methods.description: Determines the appropriate return address actor for responses.

methods.name: appendConnectionAcknowledgementsToSignal
methods.description: Adds connection acknowledgements requests to a signal based on message source.

methods.name: applySignalIdEnforcement
methods.description: Enforces signal ID rules based on external message filters.

methods.name: applyInboundHeaderMapping
methods.description: Applies header mapping from external messages to signals, including header transformations.

methods.name: appendInternalHeaders
methods.description: Appends internal headers such as authorization or correlation IDs to signals.

methods.name: filterAcknowledgements
methods.description: Filters acknowledgements in a signal based on a provided filter string, with support for header-based filtering.

methods.name: appendConnectionIdToAcknowledgementOrResponse
methods.description: Appends the connection ID to acknowledgements or command responses.

methods.name: appendConnectionIdToAcknowledgements
methods.description: Appends the connection ID to a collection of acknowledgements.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization context from an external message, if available.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContextOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization context or throws an exception if not available.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContextAsEither
methods.description: Helper method returning authorization context wrapped in an Either type for error handling.

methods.name: canRequestAcks
methods.description: Checks if a signal is eligible to request acknowledgements.
